items.source: This method is not just used for reflective comparisons in subclasses but also from compiled expression code, which is why it needs to be declared as public static here.
items.translation: 此方法不仅用于子类的反射比较，还用于编译后的表达式代码，因此需要在此处声明为 `public static`。

items.source: String format for all operators is the same '(' [operand] [operator] [operand] ')'.
items.translation: 所有运算符的字符串格式均相同：`'(' [操作数] [运算符] [操作数] ')'`。

items.source:
Common supertype for operators that operate on either one or two operands.
In the case of multiply or divide there would be two operands, but for
unary plus or minus, there is only one.
items.translation: 操作一元或二元运算符的通用基类型。对于乘法或除法，会有两个操作数，但对于一元正号或负号，则只有一个操作数。

items.source:
Numeric comparison operators share very similar generated code, only differing in
two comparison instructions.
items.translation: 数值比较运算符生成的代码非常相似，仅在两条比较指令上有所不同。

items.source:
A descriptor comparison encapsulates the result of comparing descriptor
for two operands and describes at what level they are compatible.
items.translation: 描述符比较封装了对两个操作数的描述符比较结果，并描述了它们兼容的级别。

items.source: Perform an equality check for the given operand values.
items.translation: 对给定的操作数执行相等性检查。

items.source: Andy Clement, Juergen Hoeller, Giovanni Dall'Oglio Risso, Sam Brannen
items.translation: Andy Clement, Juergen Hoeller, Giovanni Dall'Oglio Risso, Sam Brannen
